newsitem.title: USA: Wackenhut to acquire temp services firm.
newsitem.headline: Wackenhut to acquire temp services firm.

text.p: Wackenhut Corp said Thursday it agreed to buy Jim King Cos for about $11.5 million in Wackenhut series B non-voting, common stock and cash.
The acquisition is expected to close within 30 days, Wackenhut said in a statement.

In combination with the employee leasing business which Wackenhut established in 1996, this acquisition will form the basis for the company's expansion into corporate human resources outsourcing, it said.

It said Jim King, a privately owned recruiting firm, has $70 million in current annualized revenue almost evenly divided between temporary employment and employee leasing. It also has a small recruiting subsidiary.

"Jim King Cos strengthens our employee leasing business, especially in Florida where we have experienced strong growth in its first full quarter of operation," said Richard R. Wackenhut, president and chief operating officer.
"I expect this business area to account for about 10 percent of the corporation's 1997 revenue, which is expected to exceed $1 billion," he said.
